parameters.name: Expiration
parameters.description: The expiration time. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds and cannot be earlier than the current time. If you set both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence.

parameters.name: ExpirationTtl
parameters.description: The expiration time. This is a relative time in seconds. If you set both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: The name of the key that you want to set. The key can be up to 512 characters in length and cannot contain spaces or backslashes (/).

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The content of the key. The maximum size is 2 MB (2 × 1,000 × 1,000 bytes).
